lines.dialogue: Do you get out in the field much?

lines.dialogue: Hire me or fire me. It’s entirely up to you. M If he says he’s ready, he’s ready.

lines.scene: INT. MI-6 BUNKER - M’S OFFICE - DAY
lines.dialogue: Him.

lines.scene: INT. MI-6 BUNKER - M’S OFFICE - DAY
lines.dialogue: So how do we find him?

lines.scene: INT. MI-6 BUNKER - M’S OFFICE - DAY
lines.dialogue: With pleasure.

lines.scene: INT. MI-6 BUNKER - M’S OFFICE - DAY
lines.dialogue: Is there anything else you want to tell me? M No. M Report to the new Quartermaster for your documentation. He hasn’t set up shop yet, but Tanner will put you two together... Good luck.

lines.scene: INT. MI-6 BUNKER - M’S OFFICE - DAY
lines.dialogue: Thank you. M 007... doorway) ...You are ready for this?

lines.scene: INT. MI-6 BUNKER - M’S OFFICE - DAY
lines.dialogue: Yes, ma’am.
A bloody big ship... Excuse me. Q 007 ... I’m your new Quartermaster.
You must be joking. Q Why? Because I’m not wearing a lab coat?
Because you still have spots. Q My complexion is hardly relevant.
Your competence is. 42 Q Age is no guarantee of efficiency.
And youth is no guarantee of innovation. Q I’ll hazard I can do more damage on my laptop sitting in my pajamas before my first cup of Earl Grey than you can do in a year in the field.
Oh, so why do you need me? Q Every now and then, a trigger has to be pulled.

Or not pulled ... It’s hard to know which in your pajamas. BOND Q. Q 007. Ticket to Shanghai. Documentation and passport ... And this. Q Walther PPK/S 9mm short. Those are micro-dermal sensors in the grip. It’s been coded to your palm print, so only you can fire it ... Less of a random killing machine, more of a personal statement. 43
And this? Q Standard issue radio transmitter. Activate it and it broadcasts your location. Distress signal. Q ...And that’s it.
A gun. And a radio.
Not exactly Christmas is it? Q Were you expecting an exploding pen? We don’t really go in for that anymore. Q Good luck out there in the field. And please return the equipment in one piece.
Brave new world...

lines.scene: INT. SHANGHAI OFFICE TOWER - 67TH FLOOR - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Who’s got the list?

lines.scene: INT. SHANGHAI OFFICE TOWER - 67TH FLOOR - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Tell me who you’re working for? 50
I didn’t order anything... Not even you.
Aren’t you a little over-qualified to be delivering messages?
Of course he is.
It was only a matter of time.
Well I like to do some things the old-fashioned way. 53

lines.scene: EXT. MACAO HOTEL ROOM - BALCONY - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: M’s already briefed me on the list. Raising the tantalizing question of what you’re really doing here.

lines.scene: EXT. MACAO HOTEL ROOM - BALCONY - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Like spying for Mallory.

lines.scene: EXT. MACAO HOTEL ROOM - BALCONY - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: He’s a bureaucrat.

lines.scene: EXT. MACAO HOTEL ROOM - BALCONY - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Lieutenant-Colonel in Northern Ireland, Hereford Regiment. Spent three months at the hands of the IRA...

lines.scene: EXT. MACAO HOTEL ROOM - BALCONY - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: We’ll see...

lines.scene: EXT. MACAO HOTEL ROOM - BALCONY - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: And what part’s that?
Good Evening.
Don’t touch your ear. I’ve got three exits and lots of blind spots.
You look beautiful in that dress.
It’s amazing what one can do with an extra pair of hands.
You gamble?
I’d like to cash this in, please.
approach) Let’s hope so.
Thank you.
Maybe I’ll even stretch to two. I’m guessing I’ve got four million Euros in here.
floor) Well why don’t we play another.
A little like our friend in Shanghai. 58
Did I over-complicate the plot?
Bond... James Bond.
I’d like that. Will your friends be joining us?

lines.scene: INT. THE FLOATING DRAGON - MAIN FLOOR - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Now now.

lines.scene: INT. THE FLOATING DRAGON - MAIN FLOOR - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: I’ll keep you posted. 59

lines.scene: INT. THE FLOATING DRAGON - BAR - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Perfect.

lines.scene: INT. THE FLOATING DRAGON - BAR - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Depends on the question.

lines.scene: INT. THE FLOATING DRAGON - BAR - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: A subject in which you’re well- versed.

lines.scene: INT. THE FLOATING DRAGON - BAR - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Only a certain kind of woman wears a backless dress and a Beretta strapped to her thigh.

lines.scene: INT. THE FLOATING DRAGON - BAR - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Yes.

lines.scene: INT. THE FLOATING DRAGON - BAR - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: I want to meet your employer. 60

lines.scene: INT. THE FLOATING DRAGON - BAR - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: You’re scared.

lines.scene: INT. THE FLOATING DRAGON - BAR - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: You put on a good show but ever since we sat down you haven’t stopped looking at your bodyguards. Three of them’s a bit excessive. They’re controlling you, they’re not protecting you. The tattoo on your wrist is Macao sex trade. You belonged to one of the houses. What were you? Twelve? Thirteen? I’m guessing he was your way out. Perhaps you thought you were in love, but that was a long time ago.

lines.scene: INT. THE FLOATING DRAGON - BAR - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: I know when a woman is afraid and pretending not to be.

lines.scene: INT. THE FLOATING DRAGON - BAR - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: All there is. 61

lines.scene: INT. THE FLOATING DRAGON - BAR - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: I can help you.

lines.scene: INT. THE FLOATING DRAGON - BAR - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Let me try.

lines.scene: INT. THE FLOATING DRAGON - BAR - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Bring me to him.

lines.scene: INT. THE FLOATING DRAGON - BAR - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Yes.

lines.scene: INT. THE FLOATING DRAGON - BAR - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Someone usually dies.

lines.scene: INT. THE FLOATING DRAGON - COURTYARD - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Good luck with that.

lines.scene: INT. THE FLOATING DRAGON - COURTYARD - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Thank you. 64

lines.scene: INT. THE FLOATING DRAGON - COURTYARD - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Put it all on red.

lines.scene: INT. THE FLOATING DRAGON - COURTYARD - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Circle of life...
I like you better without your Beretta. 65
I wouldn’t be so sure...
Does he always get what he wants?
I made my own choices.
Station H? Am I right? Hong Kong?
Don’t forget my pathetic love of country.
She’s never lied to me.
Yes.
Well, she never tied me to a chair.
Are you sure this is about M?
What makes you think this is my first time?
Or a gas explosion in London?
Well, everybody needs a hobby.
Resurrection.
It’s a waste of a good Scotch. 77
Who says I’m on my own?
Latest thing from Q-branch. It’s called radio.

Yes, Ma’am. M His name is Tiago Rodriguez. He was a brilliant agent. But he started operating beyond his brief, hacking the Chinese. The hand-over was coming up and they were on to him so I gave him up. I got six agents back in return and a peaceful transition.

lines.scene: INT. MI-6 BUNKER - Q BRANCH - DAY
lines.dialogue: Of course there are. Can you get past them? Q I invented them. Q Right then ... Let’s see what you’ve got for us, Mr. Silva... Q We’re in.

lines.scene: INT. MI-6 BUNKER - Q BRANCH - DAY
lines.dialogue: Stop. BOND Go in on that. BOND Granborough ... Granborough Road. That’s an old tube stop on the Metropolitan line. Been closed for years. Use that as a key. Q Oh, look, it’s a map... BOND It’s London... subterranean London... Q What’s going on? Why are the doors open? Q Oh, no... Can someone tell me how the hell he got into our system? 86

lines.scene: INT. MI-6 BUNKER - OBSERVATION/ISOLATION CHAMBERS - DAY
lines.dialogue: Oh, no.

lines.scene: INT. MI-6 BUNKER - OBSERVATION/ISOLATION CHAMBERS - DAY
lines.dialogue: Q, he’s gone.
I’m in a staircase below isolation. 87

lines.scene: INT. MI-6 BUNKER - Q BRANCH - DAY
lines.dialogue: Do you read me, Q? Q I can hear you. I’m looking for you.
I’m in the Tube.

lines.scene: INT. MI-6 BUNKER - Q BRANCH - INTERCUT - DAY
lines.dialogue: ...I got all that. It what he’s got planned next that worries me. 89 Q District line is the closest. There should be a service door on your left.

lines.scene: INT. MI-6 BUNKER - Q BRANCH - INTERCUT - DAY
lines.dialogue: Got it ... ... It won’t open. Q Of course it will. Put your back into it.

lines.scene: INT. MI-6 BUNKER - Q BRANCH - INTERCUT - DAY
lines.dialogue: Why don’t you come down here and put your back into it!

lines.scene: INT. MI-6 BUNKER - Q BRANCH - INTERCUT - DAY
lines.dialogue: No, it’s stuck...

lines.scene: INT. MI-6 BUNKER - Q BRANCH - INTERCUT - DAY
lines.dialogue: Oh good, there’s a train coming. Q Hm ... That’s vexing... Give it another push. 90
I’m through.

lines.scene: INT. TEMPLE TUBE STATION PLATFORM - DAY
lines.dialogue: Temple tube station. Along with half of London.

lines.scene: INT. MI-6 BUNKER - Q BRANCH - DAY
lines.dialogue: I know where I am, Q. Where’s he?

lines.scene: INT. MI-6 BUNKER - Q BRANCH - DAY
lines.dialogue: There’s too many people. I can’t see him. Q Welcome to rush hour on the tube. Not something you’d know much about... 92

lines.scene: INT. TEMPLE TUBE STATION PLATFORM - DAY
lines.dialogue: Train’s leaving... Do I get on the train?

lines.scene: INT. TEMPLE TUBE STATION PLATFORM - DAY
lines.dialogue: Do I get on the train?! Q Bond?

lines.scene: INT. TEMPLE TUBE STATION PLATFORM - DAY
lines.dialogue: What? 93 Q Get on the train.
Open the door, please.
Open the door!
Health and safety. Carry on. 94
Take a wild guess Q.
Of course he is.
He’s going for M. Tell Tanner. Get her out of there.
Excuse me. 96
Move! Move!
I won’t miss next time, Mr. Silva.
Why, thank you.
I do hope that wasn’t for me..
That would be one way of looking at it. 105 M Too many people are dying because of me.

If he wants you, he’s going to have to come and get you. We’ve been one step behind Silva from the start. It’s time to get out in front. Change the game. M And I’m to be the bait? M All right. Just us. No one else.

lines.scene: INT. MI-6 BUNKER-Q BRANCH/INT. M’S CAR - DAY
lines.dialogue: I need help. Q I’m tracking the car, where are you going?

lines.scene: INT. MI-6 BUNKER-Q BRANCH/INT. M’S CAR - DAY
lines.dialogue: I’ve got M. We’re about to disappear. Q What?

lines.scene: INT. MI-6 BUNKER-Q BRANCH/INT. M’S CAR - DAY
lines.dialogue: I need you to lay a trail of bread crumbs impossible to follow for anyone except Silva. Think you can do it? 106 Q I’m guessing this isn’t strictly official?

lines.scene: INT. MI-6 BUNKER-Q BRANCH/INT. M’S CAR - DAY
lines.dialogue: Not even remotely. Q So much for my promising career in espionage....

lines.scene: EXT. EAST END STORAGE UNIT - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: We’re changing vehicles. Trouble with company cars is they have trackers. M Oh and I suppose that’s completely inconspicuous.

lines.scene: EXT. EAST END STORAGE UNIT - NIGHT
lines.dialogue: Get in. TIME CUT:
Are you going to complain the whole way? M Oh, go on then, eject me. See if I care. M So where are we going?
Back in time. Somewhere we’ll have the advantage.
You know the answer to that.
You know the whole story.
Orphans always make the best recruits.
Storm’s coming.
Uh...Mm. M No wonder you never came back.

lines.scene: INT. LODGE - CENTRAL HALLWAY/GREAT HALL - DAY
lines.dialogue: Good God. Are you still alive?

lines.scene: INT. LODGE - CENTRAL HALLWAY/GREAT HALL - DAY
lines.dialogue: M, this is Kincade. Gamekeeper here since I was a boy.

lines.scene: INT. LODGE - CENTRAL HALLWAY/GREAT HALL - DAY
lines.dialogue: Some men are coming to kill us. We’re going to kill them first.

lines.scene: INT. LODGE - CENTRAL HALLWAY/GREAT HALL - DAY
lines.dialogue: Do we still have a gun room?
No ‘we’ in it, Kincade. This is not your fight.
I’ll do my best.
No. You did your job.
I read your obituary of me. M And? 117
Appalling. M Yeah, I knew you’d hate it. I did call you “an exemplar of British fortitude.”
That bit was all right.
Are you ready?
You drop something?

lines.scene: INT. LODGE - DINING ROOM/GREAT HALL - TWILIGHT
lines.dialogue: You hurt? 121 M Only my pride. I never was a good shot.

lines.scene: INT. LODGE - DINING ROOM/GREAT HALL - TWILIGHT
lines.dialogue: He’s not here. He’s not here.
Always got to make an entrance. You two, go to the kitchen... now!
Get behind the arch!
Go to the chapel, use the tunnel.
I always hated this place.
Last. Rat. Standing. M 007, what took you so long?
Well, I got into some deep water. M I suppose it’s too late to make a run for it?
Well I’m game if you are. M I did get one thing right... 136
Hate to waste a view.
I thought you were going back out on active service.
If it helps, I feel a lot safer.
Just the opposite. 137
Thank you.
You know, we’ve never been formally introduced.
I look forward to our time together, Miss Moneypenny.
Good morning, Tanner.
How’s the arm, sir?
With pleasure, M.
With pleasure.
